verdict.rationale: Jan's API reference says the local OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint "Supports streaming". The server is a llama.cpp-powered drop-in replacement for cloud APIs at localhost:1337, so applications can receive tokens as they are generated. Missing for 10: detailed streaming documentation (SSE format, chunk schema, a streaming code example), confirmation that streaming also works on the Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
